title: Agnus (Vinders, Missa Stabat mater)
desc: Jheronimus Vinders, Missa Stabat mater, Agnus. 6 voices (Superius I, Superius II, Altus, Tenor I, Tenor II, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
